summary: Implemented TASK-018: Advertising Platform Integrations. Created a comprehensive ads platform integration framework with support for Google Ads, Meta Ads (Facebook/Instagram), and LinkedIn Ads. Implemented base abstract class with common functionality, platform-specific implementations, campaign/ad group/ad CRUD operations, performance tracking, bid optimization, and platform-specific optimization suggestions. All implementations include proper error handling, authentication flows, and type safety with dataclasses.
current_status: TASK-018 completed. All three advertising platform integrations implemented with full campaign management capabilities including Google Ads (search, display, video, shopping), Meta Ads (Facebook/Instagram feed, stories, reels), and LinkedIn Ads (sponsored content, messaging, text ads).
next_steps: Add unit tests for all platform implementations
Create example usage scripts demonstrating the integrations
Add API integration (actual HTTP requests to platform APIs)
Add retry logic and rate limiting handling
Create dashboard/frontend integration for campaign management

task_details.title: Advertising Platform Integrations
subtasks_completed: TASK-018-01: Created ads platform base with abstract interface, common functionality, authentication, and campaign CRUD
TASK-018-02: Implemented Google Ads with search, display, video, and shopping ad support
TASK-018-03: Implemented Meta Ads with Facebook and Instagram support
TASK-018-04: Implemented LinkedIn Ads with sponsored content, messaging, and text ads

implementation_details.base_class: AdsPlatform abstract class with methods for authentication, campaign CRUD, ad group CRUD, ad CRUD, performance tracking, bid optimization, and optimization suggestions
implementation_details.data_models: Campaign, AdGroup, Ad, PerformanceMetrics, Targeting, OptimizationSuggestion dataclasses with proper type hints

platforms.google_ads: Supports SEARCH, DISPLAY, VIDEO, SHOPPING, PERFORMANCE_MAX campaign types with all bid strategies
platforms.meta_ads: Supports Facebook/Instagram feed, stories, reels, messenger ads with Meta Marketing API
platforms.linkedin_ads: Supports sponsored content, sponsored messaging, text ads with LinkedIn Marketing API

features: Full campaign lifecycle (create, read, update, delete)
Performance metrics with automatic calculations (CTR, CPC, CPM, ROAS)
Proper error handling with custom exceptions
Configuration management via environment variables or dict

api_integration_status: Framework implemented with simulated API responses. Actual HTTP requests to platform APIs need to be added using requests or httpx libraries. All endpoint URLs, authentication flows, and request/response structures are documented in code comments.
usage_example:
from integrations.ads import get_ads_platform

config = {'access_token': 'xxx', 'account_id': 'act_123', ...}
platform = get_ads_platform('meta', config)
platform.authenticate()
campaign = platform.create_campaign(Campaign(name='My Campaign', budget=100.0))
